sourceText:
Raspberry Chocolate Coconut Smoothie with Xocai Activ Dark Chocolate
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Friday, September 21, 2012 - 2:53pm

Ingredients




3 ozs dark chocolate (Liquid Xocai Activ)
4 ozs raspberries (Fresh Raspberries)
1 tbsp shredded coconut
5 ozs coconut water
6 ozs nonfat vanilla frozen yogurt (Vanilla Frozen Yogurt or Plain Yogurt)

Preparation

1 Place all ingredients in a blender and mix. Serves 1
